comment: Glass Dynamics impactors. yield_MPa is the mean contact pressure at which the impactor flattens or crushes (flow pressure ~2.8 x yield stress for metals, the crushing strength for ice, brick and timber). Default speeds are the test-standard or everyday values.

impactors.name: Steel ball 227 g
impactors.description: The 38 mm ball of the ECE R43 and ANSI Z26.1 impact tests.

provenance.mass_g: published: UN ECE R43 Annex 3, 227 +- 2 g
provenance.yield_MPa: estimated: hardened bearing steel flow pressure (Tabor, ~2.8 x 2 GPa)
provenance.speed_ms: published: ECE R43 toughened-glass ball test, 2.0 m drop height

impactors.name: Steel ball 2.26 kg
impactors.description: The 82 mm ball of the windscreen penetration test.

provenance.mass_g: published: UN ECE R43 Annex 6, 2260 +- 20 g
provenance.speed_ms: published: ECE R43 / ANSI Z26.1 Test 26, 4 m drop height

impactors.name: Baseball
impactors.description: A 145 g ball at a 90 mph pitch.

provenance.mass_g: published: MLB Official Rules 3.01, 142-149 g
provenance.youngs_GPa: estimated: effective Hertz modulus reproducing the ~0.7-1 ms rigid-wall contact time
provenance.restitution: published: MLB ball COR 0.514-0.578 at 26.8 m/s

impactors.name: Golf ball
impactors.description: Off the driver at 70 m/s.

provenance.mass_g: published: R&A / USGA Rules of Golf, 45.93 g maximum
provenance.youngs_GPa: estimated: effective Hertz modulus for a ~0.45 ms rigid-wall contact

impactors.name: Steel BB 4.5 mm
impactors.description: An airgun BB: small, hard and fast. Leaves a cone-shaped hole.

impactors.name: Road stone
impactors.description: A 6 g crushed-granite chip thrown up by a lorry, meeting the car at a closing speed of 30 m/s on a sharp corner.

provenance.tip_angle_deg: estimated: a blunt corner of a crushed-aggregate chip
provenance.yield_MPa: estimated: the chip's corner crushes at about this contact pressure, capping the force
provenance.youngs_GPa: published: granite 40-70 GPa (quartz grains harder than glass, so the chip indents it)

impactors.name: Hailstone 50 mm
impactors.description: Severe hail at terminal velocity. The ice crushes as it hits.

provenance.mass_g: published: ice sphere, 900 kg/m3 (hail density 0.8-0.92 g/cm3)
provenance.speed_ms: published: terminal velocity of 50 mm hail, ~32-35 m/s (FM 4473 / ASTM E822 tables)
provenance.yield_MPa: published: dynamic crushing strength of hail ice, ~5-25 MPa (Kim & Kedward 2000)

impactors.name: Claw hammer
impactors.description: A 0.57 kg head swung at 10 m/s; arm and handle add about 0.6 kg of effective mass.

provenance.mass_g: estimated: 0.57 kg head plus effective handle and arm mass

impactors.name: Brick
impactors.description: A thrown house brick, landing on a corner.

provenance.mass_g: published: standard clay brick 2.2-2.5 kg
provenance.yield_MPa: published: fired clay brick compressive strength 20-60 MPa

impactors.name: Spring window punch
impactors.description: A carbide tip driven by a spring hammer. Shatters tempered glass, only chips annealed or laminated.

provenance.mass_g: estimated: spring-loaded centre punch hammer mass

impactors.name: Pedestrian headform 4.5 kg

provenance.youngs_GPa: estimated: vinyl skin over an aluminium sphere, effective Hertz modulus

impactors.name: Body-impact bag 45 kg
impactors.description: The shot bag of the CPSC / ANSI Z97.1 safety-glazing test: a person falling into a door.

provenance.speed_ms: published: 48 in (1219 mm) drop height, Category II

impactors.name: 7.62 x 51 mm NATO ball

provenance.yield_MPa: estimated: lead core in a gilding-metal jacket, harder than a pistol bullet

impactors.name: .50 BMG ball
impactors.description: 12.7 x 99 mm heavy machine-gun round: a 708 gr (45.9 g) full metal jacket bullet at UL 752 Level 10 velocity, about five times the energy of a 7.62 mm rifle round.

provenance.yield_MPa: estimated: a long lead-and-steel core in a gilding-metal jacket, harder to flatten than a rifle ball

impactors.name: Bird 1.8 kg (4 lb)

provenance.speed_ms: estimated: 250 kt, a typical low-altitude speed; V_C at sea level is higher for most jets

impactors.name: 9 mm FMJ from a submachine gun
impactors.description: 124 gr full metal jacket from a short-barrelled submachine gun: the round the armoured windscreen is rated against, fired at hundreds of rounds a minute.

provenance.speed_ms: published: typical 9 mm FMJ from a 225 mm submachine-gun barrel, ~390-410 m/s

impactors.name: 00 buckshot (9 pellets)
impactors.description: A 12-gauge 00 buck shell at 7 m: nine 8.4 mm lead balls in a pattern about 20 cm across, arriving one after another. Mass and energy shown are per pellet.

provenance.mass_g: published: 00 buck pellet 0.33 in (8.38 mm), 53.8 gr (3.49 g); 9 per 2-3/4 in 12-gauge shell
provenance.speed_ms: published: 1,325 ft/s (404 m/s) muzzle for standard 00 buck loads; about 395 m/s at 7 m
provenance.spread_mrad: estimated: a cylinder-bore pattern of about 1 in per yard, 90 % of pellets within about 20 cm at 7 m
provenance.yield_MPa: estimated: antimony-hardened lead shot, dynamic flow stress
provenance.shot_string_m: estimated: shot string of a few tens of centimetres at short range

impactors.name: Hand grenade (thrown)
impactors.description: A 400 g steel-bodied fragmentation grenade. In the glass lab it goes off 1.5 s after the throw, wherever it has got to: its steel, then its blast wave. Lobbed, it bounces off tempered glass and goes off at the foot of the pane; thrown hard, it goes through first.

provenance.mass_g: published: M67 fragmentation grenade, 14 oz (400 g), 2.5 in (64 mm) diameter
provenance.speed_ms: estimated: a lob against the glass (a hard overarm throw is about 20 m/s)

impactors.name: Grenade fragment
impactors.description: A steel splinter of a fragmentation grenade's body: a fraction of a gram at well over a kilometre a second, ahead of the blast.

provenance.mass_g: estimated: notched-coil or pre-formed fragments of an M67-class grenade, about 0.1-0.3 g
provenance.speed_ms: estimated: Gurney velocity of a thin steel case on Composition B, about 1.2-1.6 km/s

impactors.name: 9-pounder cannonball
impactors.description: Round shot of a Revolutionary War field gun: a 4 kg cast-iron ball fired at about the speed of sound.

provenance.mass_g: published: a 9-pounder's nominal 9 lb (4.08 kg) iron round shot, about 4 in (102 mm) across
provenance.speed_ms: estimated: smoothbore field guns of the period, about 1,400-1,500 ft/s with a full charge
provenance.yield_MPa: estimated: grey cast iron in compression

impactors.name: 40 mm HE grenade (impact-fused)
impactors.description: A grenade-launcher round: 230 g, fired at 76 m/s, goes off the instant it touches something. In the glass lab it bursts against the pane: about 32 g of explosive and a few hundred steel fragments at point-blank range.

provenance.mass_g: published: M406 40 x 46 mm HE cartridge projectile, about 230 g, 32 g Composition B
provenance.speed_ms: published: M79 / M203 muzzle velocity, 76 m/s
